system.description: Your Craving's active half (its own SL): Mesmerizing — 5 MP on an Opposed Check inflicts dazed, subtly (+SL to stay unnoticed); Pestilent — 5 MP at round start, every weak creature, friend or foe, takes (SL × 2) poison (× 4 at level 40+) and you recover half as HP; Terrifying — +(SL) damage per shaken creature in the scene, friend or foe; Inevitable — in a chase, spend up to (SL × 20) MP: per 20, inflict slow or fill a pursuit-clock section.
